writer_contract.authorization: Nonreturning increment then atomic read of OPEN and matching phase, with the increment already counted. Seal clears OPEN; accepted writers drain by counted release; late rejected entrants modify only gate bookkeeping.
writer_contract.finite_active_precondition: 61bit COUNT is simultaneous callbacks, not cumulative events. Active invocation depth must remain below this bound; finite kernel stack/memory prevents physical approach to2^61. No unconditional proof for forged-overflow concurrent words.
writer_contract.record_Get_reservation: At most16 CAS attempts under an existing lease. bad2/bad3 on reservation failure makes capture incomplete; successful-reservation counters are then only lower bounds, not exact lost-event counts. No unbounded retry or silently qualified drop.
writer_contract.snapshot: Disable, detach attempts and closed/drained gate precede streaming every reserved record including missing commits. FD close alone is not the writer fence.
